Delay and picture sync
Audio delay is the time between something happening and hearing it — for example, a game tap and its sound.
Desync means sound and picture do not line up: lips may move before you hear the voice. More buffering, Bluetooth and phone effects can add delay.
For videos and games, try Lowest if sound stays smooth. Increase buffering if you hear crackles or short pauses. Sukut cannot automatically correct every app’s video timing.
